treatments.name: Root Canal Treatment
treatments.metaTitle: Root Canal Treatment in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Save an infected or painful tooth with root canal treatment. Clear explanations and comfortable care at Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Root canal treatment saves a tooth whose inner pulp has become infected or inflamed. The damaged pulp is removed, the canals are cleaned and disinfected, then sealed so the tooth can keep working.
whoFor: Lingering pain with hot or cold, or a toothache that wakes you at night
A deep cavity or crack that has reached the nerve
Swelling or a pimple on the gum near a tooth
A tooth that has darkened after an injury

steps.title: Examination and X-ray
steps.text: We check the tooth and take an X-ray to see the roots and the extent of infection.

steps.title: Numbing
steps.text: Local anaesthetic numbs the area so the procedure feels much like having a filling.

steps.title: Cleaning the canals
steps.text: The infected pulp is removed and the canals are shaped, cleaned and disinfected.

steps.title: Sealing
steps.text: The canals are filled and sealed. Depending on the tooth, this may take one or more visits.

steps.title: Protecting the tooth
steps.text: Back teeth usually need a crown afterwards to protect them from cracking.

aftercare: Some tenderness for a few days is normal; your dentist will advise on pain relief.
Avoid chewing hard food on the tooth until the final filling or crown is placed.
Keep brushing and flossing normally, and attend the follow-up visits.

faqs.q: Does a root canal hurt?
faqs.a: The procedure is done under local anaesthetic, so most patients feel pressure rather than pain. It usually relieves the pain the infection was causing.

faqs.q: Is it better to remove the tooth instead?
faqs.a: Keeping your natural tooth is usually the better choice for chewing and for the bone around it. Your dentist will explain the options for your tooth.

faqs.q: Will I need a crown?
faqs.a: Back teeth often do, because a root-treated tooth can become brittle. Your dentist will advise based on how much tooth structure remains.

treatments.name: Dental Fillings
treatments.metaTitle: Tooth-Coloured Dental Fillings in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Repair cavities and chipped teeth with natural-looking fillings at our Mapusa and Candolim clinics in Goa.
treatments.summary: Dental fillings restore teeth damaged by decay, cracks or wear. The decayed part is removed and the tooth is rebuilt with a filling material, usually tooth-coloured.
whoFor: Cavities found at a check-up or on an X-ray
Sensitivity to sweet, hot or cold food
Small chips, cracks or worn edges
Old fillings that have broken or leak

steps.title: Check and numbing
steps.text: We examine the tooth and numb it if needed.

steps.title: Removing decay
steps.text: The decayed or damaged part of the tooth is gently removed and cleaned.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: The tooth is rebuilt in layers, shaped to your bite and polished.

aftercare: If you were numbed, wait until the feeling returns before eating.
Mild sensitivity can last a few days; tell us if your bite feels high.
Brush twice a day and cut down on sugary snacks to prevent new cavities.

faqs.q: How long does a filling take?
faqs.a: Most fillings are done in a single visit.

faqs.q: Can I eat after a filling?
faqs.a: Yes, once the numbness wears off. Your dentist will tell you if your filling material needs any extra care.

treatments.name: Teeth Cleaning & Scaling
treatments.metaTitle: Teeth Cleaning & Scaling in Goa | Expressions Dental Clinic
treatments.metaDescription: Professional teeth cleaning removes tartar and plaque to keep gums healthy. Book at our Duler (Mapusa) or Candolim clinic.
treatments.summary: Scaling is a professional clean that removes hardened plaque (tartar or calculus) that brushing cannot. It helps prevent gum disease, bad breath and staining.
whoFor: Everyone, as part of regular check-ups
Gums that bleed when brushing
Visible yellow or brown deposits near the gum line
Persistent bad breath

steps.title: Gum check
steps.text: We check your gums and how much tartar has built up.

steps.title: Scaling
steps.text: Instruments remove tartar from above and just below the gum line.

steps.title: Polishing
steps.text: Teeth are polished to remove surface stains and smooth the surfaces.

aftercare: Gums may feel tender or bleed slightly for a day or two.
Teeth can feel sensitive briefly; a sensitivity toothpaste helps.
Keep up brushing and flossing so tartar builds up more slowly.

faqs.q: Does scaling damage the enamel?
faqs.a: No. Scaling removes deposits sitting on the teeth; it does not remove enamel.

faqs.q: How often should I have my teeth cleaned?
faqs.a: Many people benefit from a clean every six months; your dentist will suggest what suits your gums.

treatments.name: Dentures
treatments.metaTitle: Full & Partial Dentures in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Comfortable, natural-looking full and partial dentures to replace missing teeth. Talk to us about your options.
treatments.summary: A denture is a removable replacement for missing teeth and the surrounding gum tissue. Dentures can replace a few teeth (partial) or a full arch (complete).
whoFor: Several or all teeth missing in an arch
Difficulty chewing or speaking because of missing teeth
People who prefer a removable option, or for whom implants are not suitable

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We examine your mouth and discuss partial, complete or implant-supported options.

steps.title: Impressions and bite
steps.text: Moulds and bite records are taken so the denture fits your mouth and face.

steps.title: Try-in
steps.text: You try a trial version to check the look, fit and bite before it is finalised.

steps.title: Fitting and adjustments
steps.text: The finished denture is fitted, with follow-up visits to ease any sore spots.

aftercare: It takes a few weeks to get used to eating and speaking with a new denture.
Remove and clean your denture daily, and rest your gums at night if advised.
Come back if anything rubs or the fit changes over time.

faqs.q: Will people notice I wear dentures?
faqs.a: Modern dentures are made to look natural, with teeth chosen to suit your face.

faqs.q: Can dentures be fixed in place?
faqs.a: Implants can be used to hold a denture more securely. Ask us whether this is an option for you.

treatments.name: Dental Crowns
treatments.metaTitle: Dental Crowns (Caps) in Goa | Expressions Dental Clinic
treatments.metaDescription: Restore broken, weak or root-treated teeth with a dental crown. Natural-looking options at our Mapusa and Candolim clinics.
treatments.summary: A crown is a tooth-shaped cap placed over a tooth to restore its shape, size and strength, and to improve how it looks and works.
whoFor: Teeth that are cracked, broken or heavily filled
Back teeth after root canal treatment
Badly worn or discoloured teeth
Covering a dental implant

steps.title: Preparing the tooth
steps.text: The tooth is numbed and reshaped so the crown can fit over it.

steps.title: Measuring
steps.text: An impression or scan records the tooth and your bite.

steps.title: Temporary protection
steps.text: A temporary crown may be placed while the final crown is made.

steps.title: Fitting
steps.text: The final crown is checked for fit, colour and bite, then cemented in place.

aftercare: Avoid very sticky or hard food on a temporary crown.
Brush and floss around the crown like a natural tooth.
Tell us if your bite feels uneven after fitting.

faqs.q: What are crowns made of?
faqs.a: Options include all-ceramic and metal-ceramic crowns. Your dentist will recommend one based on the tooth's position and strength needs.

faqs.q: How long do crowns last?
faqs.a: With good care, crowns can last many years. Regular check-ups help spot problems early.

treatments.name: Tooth Extraction
treatments.metaTitle: Tooth Extraction in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Gentle tooth removal when a tooth can't be saved, with clear aftercare advice. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: A dental extraction is the removal of a tooth from its socket in the jaw bone. It is considered when a tooth cannot be saved or is causing problems.
whoFor: Teeth too damaged or decayed to repair
Severe gum disease with loose teeth
Crowding before orthodontic treatment, when advised
Wisdom teeth causing pain or infection

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We examine the tooth, take an X-ray if needed, and talk through alternatives.

steps.title: Numbing
steps.text: Local anaesthetic numbs the tooth and surrounding area.

steps.title: Removal
steps.text: The tooth is gently loosened and removed. Some teeth need a minor surgical approach.

steps.title: Healing
steps.text: Gauze is placed to help a clot form, and you receive written aftercare instructions.

aftercare: Bite on the gauze as advised and avoid rinsing hard for the first 24 hours.
Do not smoke or drink through a straw while the socket heals.
Eat soft food and keep the area clean as instructed. Contact us if bleeding or pain increases.

faqs.q: Should a missing tooth be replaced?
faqs.a: Often yes, to prevent neighbouring teeth from drifting. Options include implants, bridges and dentures.

treatments.name: Child Dental Care
treatments.metaTitle: Children's Dentist in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Gentle dental care for children, from first visits to habits like thumb sucking. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Many children are found to have oral habits like thumb sucking, which may affect normal growth. We provide care designed for children, from first check-ups to treating these habits and cavities.
whoFor: A first dental visit by the first birthday, or soon after the first tooth appears
Thumb sucking, tongue thrusting or mouth breathing
Cavities, toothache or injuries to baby or adult teeth
Advice on brushing, diet and fluoride for your child

steps.title: A friendly first visit
steps.text: We take it slowly so your child gets comfortable with the chair and the team.

steps.title: Check-up
steps.text: We check teeth, gums, bite and habits, and explain what we see.

steps.title: Prevention and treatment
steps.text: We suggest preventive care and treat any problems in a child-friendly way.

aftercare: Brush your child's teeth twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste suitable for their age.
Limit sugary drinks and snacks between meals.
Keep up regular check-ups so small problems are caught early.

faqs.q: When should my child first see a dentist?
faqs.a: Ideally by their first birthday, or within six months of the first tooth appearing.

faqs.q: Why treat baby teeth if they fall out anyway?
faqs.a: Healthy baby teeth help with eating, speech and holding space for the adult teeth.

treatments.name: Dental Implants
treatments.metaTitle: Dental Implants in Goa | Expressions Dental Clinic
treatments.metaDescription: Replace missing teeth with dental implants that look and feel natural. Consultations at our Mapusa and Candolim clinics.
treatments.summary: A dental implant is a root replacement, usually made of titanium, placed in the jaw bone to support a crown, bridge or denture. It can replace one or several missing teeth.
whoFor: One or more missing teeth
Loose dentures that need more support
Adults with healthy gums and enough bone, or who can have bone grafting

steps.title: Consultation and planning
steps.text: We examine your mouth, take X-rays or scans, and plan the implant position.

steps.title: Implant placement
steps.text: Under local anaesthetic, the implant is placed into the jaw bone.

steps.title: Healing
steps.text: The bone bonds to the implant over a period of weeks to months.

steps.title: The new tooth
steps.text: A connector (abutment) and a custom crown, bridge or denture are fitted on the implant.

aftercare: Follow the post-surgery instructions and take any prescribed medicines as directed.
Clean around implants carefully every day, like natural teeth.
Avoid smoking, which increases the risk of implant problems.
Attend regular check-ups so we can monitor the implant and gums.

faqs.q: Am I suitable for implants?
faqs.a: Most healthy adults are. Bone levels, gum health, smoking and some medical conditions affect suitability; your dentist will assess this.

faqs.q: How long does the whole process take?
faqs.a: It depends on bone healing and whether grafting is needed. Your dentist will give you a timeline at the consultation.

faqs.q: Does it hurt?
faqs.a: Placement is done under local anaesthetic. Discomfort afterwards is usually manageable with the advised pain relief.

treatments.name: Gum Surgery
treatments.metaTitle: Gum Disease Treatment & Gum Surgery in Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Treatment for advanced gum disease to remove bacteria below the gums and protect your teeth. Expressions Dental Clinic.
treatments.summary: Periodontal (gum) surgery treats advanced gum disease by removing bacteria and tartar from deep below the gums, and reshaping or repairing the gum and bone where needed.
whoFor: Deep gum pockets that do not respond to cleaning
Bleeding, receding or swollen gums
Loose teeth caused by gum disease

steps.title: Gum assessment
steps.text: We measure gum pockets and take X-rays to check bone levels.

steps.title: Deep cleaning first
steps.text: Non-surgical deep cleaning is usually tried before surgery.

steps.title: Surgical treatment
steps.text: Under local anaesthetic, deep deposits are removed and the gums are repositioned or repaired.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Follow-up visits check healing and gum health.

aftercare: Use any prescribed mouthwash and medicines as directed.
Eat soft food and avoid the treated area while it heals.
Regular professional cleaning is important to keep gum disease under control.

faqs.q: Can gum disease affect my general health?
faqs.a: Research links gum disease with conditions such as diabetes. Keeping your gums healthy is part of looking after your overall health.

treatments.name: Orthodontic Treatment (Braces)
treatments.metaDescription: Straighten teeth and improve your bite with orthodontic treatment for children and adults. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Orthodontic treatment straightens or moves teeth to improve their appearance and how they work, using braces or other appliances.
whoFor: Crowded, gapped or crooked teeth
Overbite, underbite or crossbite
Children whose jaws and teeth are still developing, and adults

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: We examine your teeth and bite and take records such as photos, X-rays and impressions.

steps.title: Treatment plan
steps.text: Your dentist explains the options, expected duration and what is involved.

steps.title: Fitting
steps.text: Braces or appliances are fitted and adjusted at regular visits.

steps.title: Retention
steps.text: Retainers help keep teeth in their new position once treatment ends.

aftercare: Clean carefully around braces, using interdental brushes if advised.
Avoid hard and sticky food that can damage braces.
Wear retainers exactly as instructed.

faqs.q: Is there an age limit for braces?
faqs.a: No. Adults can have orthodontic treatment as long as their teeth and gums are healthy.

faqs.q: How long does treatment take?
faqs.a: It depends on the case. Your dentist will estimate the duration after the assessment.

treatments.name: Impacted Tooth Removal
treatments.metaTitle: Impacted Wisdom Tooth Removal in Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Removal of impacted wisdom teeth that cause pain, swelling or infection. Expressions Dental Clinic, Mapusa & Candolim.
treatments.summary: An impacted tooth is one that fails to fully emerge through the gum, most commonly a wisdom tooth. When it causes problems, it can be removed with minor oral surgery.
whoFor: Pain, swelling or infection around a partly erupted wisdom tooth
Food trapping and decay in a hard-to-clean area
Damage to the neighbouring tooth

steps.title: X-ray assessment
steps.text: An X-ray shows the tooth's position and its relation to nearby nerves.

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: Your dentist explains the procedure, risks and recovery.

steps.title: Removal
steps.text: Under local anaesthetic, the tooth is removed, sometimes in sections.

steps.title: Recovery
steps.text: You receive aftercare instructions and a follow-up appointment if needed.

aftercare: Some swelling and stiffness for a few days is common; cold compresses help in the first day.
Eat soft food, avoid smoking and do not rinse hard for 24 hours.
Contact us if pain worsens after a few days, or for fever or heavy bleeding.

faqs.q: Do all wisdom teeth need to be removed?
faqs.a: No. Wisdom teeth that are healthy and causing no problems can often stay. Your dentist will advise.

treatments.name: Smile Designing
treatments.metaTitle: Smile Design & Smile Makeover in Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Plan your ideal smile by adjusting the size, shape, colour and alignment of your teeth. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Smile designing is a planned approach to changing the size, shape, colour and alignment of teeth, and the surrounding gums, to enhance your smile.
whoFor: Discoloured, chipped, uneven or gapped teeth
A 'gummy' or uneven gum line
People who want a coordinated plan rather than single treatments

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We discuss what you would like to change and examine your teeth, gums and bite.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Photos and models help plan the result, which we review with you.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: The plan may combine whitening, veneers, crowns, gum shaping or orthodontics.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: We check the result and your bite, and advise on keeping your smile healthy.

aftercare: Keep up regular check-ups and cleaning to protect your new smile.
Limit staining food and drinks, and do not smoke.

faqs.q: Can I see the result before treatment?
faqs.a: The planning stage is designed to show you the expected outcome so you can decide before committing.

treatments.name: Laminate Veneers
treatments.metaDescription: Thin, natural-looking veneers to improve the shape, spacing and colour of your front teeth. Expressions Dental Clinic.
treatments.summary: Veneers are thin, translucent laminates bonded to the front of teeth to improve their appearance: shape, spacing and colour. They can also correct mild crowding or replace old composite bonding.
whoFor: Stained teeth that whitening cannot brighten
Small gaps, chips or uneven edges
Mildly crowded or misshapen front teeth

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: We discuss the look you want and check that veneers suit your teeth and bite.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: A thin layer of enamel may be reshaped, and impressions are taken.

steps.title: Bonding
steps.text: The veneers are tried in, adjusted and bonded to your teeth.

aftercare: Avoid biting very hard objects such as ice or pens.
Wear a night guard if you grind your teeth.
Brush and floss normally and attend regular check-ups.

faqs.q: Are veneers permanent?
faqs.a: Veneers last many years but may need replacing eventually. Because enamel is usually reshaped, the decision should be considered carefully.

treatments.name: Ceramic Crowns
treatments.metaDescription: Metal-free ceramic crowns that blend in with your natural teeth. Expressions Dental Clinic, Mapusa & Candolim.
treatments.summary: Cosmetic crowns are made from translucent ceramic materials that look attractive and blend in well with the rest of your teeth.
whoFor: Visible teeth that need a crown
Replacing older crowns with dark edges
People who prefer metal-free restorations

steps.title: Shade matching
steps.text: We match the ceramic colour to your neighbouring teeth.

steps.title: Preparation and impression
steps.text: The tooth is shaped and an impression or scan is taken.

steps.title: Fitting
steps.text: The crown is checked for fit, colour and bite, then bonded in place.

aftercare: Brush and floss around the crown like a natural tooth.
Avoid using your teeth to open packets or bite hard objects.

faqs.q: Are ceramic crowns strong enough for back teeth?
faqs.a: Modern ceramics are strong, but the best material depends on your bite. Your dentist will recommend the right option.

treatments.name: CAD/CAM Dental Crowns
treatments.metaDescription: Precisely designed and milled crowns using computer-aided design and manufacturing. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Computer-aided design and computer-assisted milling (CAD/CAM) are used to design and manufacture crowns and other dental restorations with precision.
whoFor: Teeth that need a crown, inlay or onlay
Patients who want precisely fitting ceramic restorations

steps.title: Preparing the tooth
steps.text: The tooth is shaped to receive the restoration.

steps.title: Digital design
steps.text: The restoration is designed on a computer from a digital record of your tooth.

steps.title: Milling and fitting
steps.text: It is milled from a block of material, checked and bonded in place.

aftercare: Look after it like a natural tooth: brush, floss and attend check-ups.

faqs.q: How is CAD/CAM different from a regular crown?
faqs.a: The crown is designed and made with computer-guided tools, which allows a precise, consistent fit.

treatments.name: Gum Shaping & Depigmentation
treatments.metaTitle: Gum Depigmentation & Gum Shaping in Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Treat dark gum patches and reshape an uneven gum line for a more balanced smile. Expressions Dental Clinic.
treatments.summary: Gum depigmentation (sometimes called gum bleaching) is a cosmetic procedure to remove dark spots or patches on the gums caused by excess melanin. Gum shaping evens out an uneven or 'gummy' gum line.
whoFor: Dark patches or uneven colour on the gums
Excess gum showing when you smile
An uneven gum line around the front teeth

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We examine the gums and explain what can be achieved.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.text: Under local anaesthetic, the pigmented layer is removed or the gum line is reshaped.

steps.title: Healing
steps.text: The gums heal over the following weeks, revealing the new colour or shape.

aftercare: Eat soft, cool food for the first few days.
Follow cleaning instructions carefully while the gums heal.
Avoid smoking, which can cause pigmentation to return.

faqs.q: Can the dark colour come back?
faqs.a: Pigmentation can return over time in some people, especially smokers. Your dentist will discuss what to expect.

treatments.name: Teeth Whitening
treatments.metaTitle: Teeth Whitening in Mapusa & Candolim, Goa
treatments.metaDescription: Professional teeth whitening to lighten your natural tooth colour safely. Expressions Dental Clinic, Goa.
treatments.summary: Dental bleaching, or teeth whitening, is an effective way to lighten the natural colour of your teeth without removing any of the tooth surface.
whoFor: Teeth yellowed by age, tea, coffee or tobacco
People with healthy teeth and gums who want a brighter smile

steps.title: Check-up
steps.text: We check that your teeth and gums are healthy and note your starting shade.

steps.title: Whitening
steps.text: A professional whitening gel is applied while your gums are protected.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: We compare the result with your starting shade and advise on maintenance.

aftercare: Temporary sensitivity is common and usually settles within a few days.
Limit tea, coffee, red wine and tobacco to help the result last.
Occasional touch-ups can maintain the colour.

faqs.q: Does whitening work on crowns or fillings?
faqs.a: No. Whitening lightens natural teeth only; existing crowns or fillings may need replacing to match.

faqs.q: How long do results last?
faqs.a: Results can last a few years, depending on diet and habits such as smoking.

treatments.name: Tooth Jewellery
treatments.metaTitle: Tooth Jewellery in Goa | Expressions Dental Clinic
treatments.metaDescription: Add a little sparkle with tooth jewellery bonded safely to your tooth and removable without damage.
treatments.summary: We use tooth jewellery designed specifically to be bonded to teeth. It can be removed or changed later without damaging the tooth.
whoFor: Anyone with healthy front teeth who wants a decorative accent

steps.title: Choosing
steps.text: Pick a design and the tooth where you would like it.

steps.title: Bonding
steps.text: The tooth surface is cleaned and the jewel is bonded with a dental adhesive.

aftercare: Brush gently around the jewel.
Avoid biting hard food directly on it.
Ask us to remove it rather than trying at home.

faqs.q: Does it damage the tooth?
faqs.a: No drilling is needed. The jewel is bonded to the surface and can be removed by the dentist.
